name: Oakley Capital Investments Limited
summary: Oakley Capital Investments Limited is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in investments in early stage, series B, late stage, emerging growth, mid-markets, corporate carve-outs, buyouts, mezzanine, restructuring, management buy-outs, management buy-ins, small-mid buyout, mid-buyout, public to privates, re-financings, secondary purchases, growth capital, turnarounds, industry consolidation, business roll-outs and buy-and-build investments as well as investments in other funds. It seeks to invest in the unlisted companies and performing and under-performing companies based in Western Europe with a focus on the United Kingdom.
